Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly advised switching strategies (use IMDb’s mobile page and/or Wikipedia) due to repeated timeouts, WebSurfer continued to reload the same desktop IMDb full-credits URL, ignoring the fallback instructions. This led to redundant timeouts and no progress toward confirming the correct role (Ben Affleck as Fred O’Bannion), thereby preventing a proper resolution.
